theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), IsOpen U → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → x ∈ U → (x ∈ N → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P), 0 < δ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball x δ) ∧ MapsTo π (ball x δ) N ∧ (∀ y ∈ N ∩ ball x δ, π y = y) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖) → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ (πs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (G' : ℝ), (∀ᶠ j in atTop, dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G = ∅ ∨ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G') ∧ ∀ y ∈ dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y)) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, dilation (xs j) (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G = ∅ ∨ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
